GSAP 3.15.1 (gsap.min.js, copied unchanged from the npm package "gsap@3.15.1", dist/gsap.min.js)

The npm package ships no licence file. Its package.json says:
  "license": "Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license."
and the file header of gsap.min.js reads:
  @license Copyright 2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved.
  Subject to the terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license.
That header is kept as shipped (the licence forbids removing or altering proprietary notices).

Terms as read on https://gsap.com/standard-license on 2026-11-17 (effective 2025-04-30, last modified 2025-05-30), summarised, not a copy of the licence:
- Grant: a non-exclusive, worldwide licence to use, reproduce, display and implement GSAP Products solely for Permitted Uses, namely
  "the implementation and/or use of GSAP Products on any website, web application, or digital interface by any person or entity".
- Commercial use is covered ("Commercial usage is covered under the standard license").
- Prohibited: use in tools that let users build visual animations without code and that help create a product competing with Webflow;
  reverse engineering to make such a product; removing or altering proprietary notices or branding.
- The page says nothing explicit about shipping the library file inside a client deliverable or about offline use.
  This prototype is a presentation page (a digital interface), not an animation-building tool, so it falls under Permitted Uses on a plain reading;
  the owner should confirm before the file leaves the studio inside a client package.

Read the live terms before shipping: https://gsap.com/standard-license
